binaries.name: fsapfsinfo
binaries.why: Inspect an APFS container and its volumes. This experimental libfsapfs build does not support snapshots, Fusion drives, or T2 encryption.

binaries.name: log
binaries.why: Apple's own reader for the unified log. Only present on macOS, and the only tool that resolves the format strings properly.

install.apt: not available on Linux; use the pinned unifiedlog_iterator

binaries.not_in_image: Apple's own reader exists only on macOS. The image uses Mandiant's pinned unifiedlog_iterator on Linux.

binaries.name: mac_apt.py
binaries.why: Fifty-odd artefact plugins over a macOS or iOS image, and it reads UAC and Velociraptor collections as well as E01, DMG and sparse images.

install.apt: pinned source 1.33.2 (install.source), amd64 only: its statx helper knows no aarch64 syscall number, so it stops at import on Linux arm64

binaries.name: unifiedlog_iterator
binaries.why: Read modern macOS and iOS unified log archives off a Mac and keep every decoded entry as JSONL.
